column2: WARNING Deluge Strainer Cover Sign – Water Pressure Can Eject Cover – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Water Pressure Can Eject Cover. This WARNING Deluge Strainer Cover sign from CGAP Safety reads: DELUGE STRAINER COVER / WATER PRESSURE CAN EJECT COVER / ISOLATE AND RELIEVE PRESSURE / BEFORE UNBOLTING THE COVER. Written for Electric utility substations, transformer yards, power plants.

Why this sign matters

Trapped supply pressure behind a loosened cover bolts can blow the cover and a jet of water out, striking the person at the flange.

Where to post it

On the strainer body flange beside the cover bolts, facing the technician at the deluge valve skid.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance technicians, fire protection contractors.
